steps.title: Know the names
steps.body: Centella asiatica, cica, madecassoside and asiaticoside all come from the same leafy plant.

steps.title: Add one step
steps.body: Choose a cica toner, serum or cream and layer it after cleansing. Loved by Korean skincare fans for comfort.
